reason: I get my bread and labneh at the dekkene almost every day, a few steps away, and sometimes on the tab. I'm not going to order before 2 and then go out again at 6 to collect a bag when I can just walk down and pick things myself.
objection: What if they bring the wrong item, the wrong size, or a rotten tomato? I can't see what I'm getting, and there's no delivery, so I still have to go out to collect it.
would_change_my_mind: Home delivery, and a promise that anything wrong or spoiled is replaced or refunded on the spot when I collect it.
